"'''Tree Troubles / Big Brother's Bounty'''" is the thirteenth episode of the [[Young Jedi Adventures Season One|first season]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures]]''. It was released on [[Disney+]] on [[August 2]], [[2023]].<ref name="More YJA Episodes" />

==Official description==
''Nubs and the Jedi protect his favorite tree. The Jedi help a young bounty hunter find her brother.''
